input.prompt: Macro product film in one continuous shot: a translucent glass hummingbird unfolds its wings above a dark reflective table, the camera makes a slow 30-degree arc, cool rim light refracts into spectral highlights, delicate crystalline wing chimes and a low room tone, no cuts, photorealistic.
